title: Elementary spectral invariants and three-dimensional Reeb dynamics
summary: We survey various recent results on the existence and properties of periodic orbits of Reeb vector fields in three dimensions. We give an introduction to the "elementary spectral invariants" of contact three-manifolds, and we explain how they can be used to prove some of these results. (The remaining results can be proved using spectral invariants from embedded contact homology, of which the elementary spectral invariants are a simplification.)
